how: Each of the 42 flagged rows re-run on Google Maps (2026-11-24, by its map query, the address on the place page compared with the row); every one landed on the row's own place. 'Permanently closed' → removed. 'Temporarily closed' → one web search or the place's own / tourism page: a seasonal closure (mountain huts, the Amalfi coast, Cinque Terre, Dubrovnik's old town) kept with the season added to 'why' in both languages; no reason or reopening date → removed. Cinque Terre fell to 3 restaurants, so two restaurants open today on Maps were added.
